She taught the king her secret: went to the Buddha as my refuge. went to the Dhamma as my refuge. went to the Sangha as my refuge. By that power, the fire did not burn me.’ LG

Whoever firmly embraces the Threefol Refuge will not fall into ultimate suffering. It destroys sorrow, provides absolute safety, and grants the highest bliss. It is the only path from the fire into the lotus.

His mind purified, the king asked for forgiveness. He declared Vessamitta to be like his own mother. Following her profound example, the king and his entire tire kingdom took refuge in the Triple Gem, embracing the path of virtue.

By grasping the supreme refuge, Vessamitta found cooling peace in the midst of roaring fire. If you, too, protect the virtue of the highest refuge, how could you not attain the cooling peace of ultimate liberation?
